definitions.explanation: A format or approach based on two-way exchange, whether between people or between a person and a system. Widely used in technology (interactive software), education (dialogue-based learning), and communication contexts.

notes:
⟦{対話|たいわ}→対話：12400_taiwa⟧ means 'dialogue' or 'conversation,' and {型|がた} means 'type' or 'style.' {対話型|たいわがた} describes any system, approach, or format that involves back-and-forth interaction rather than one-way delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対話型|たいわがた}AI (interactive AI, conversational AI)
- {対話型|たいわがた}⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (dialogue-based class)
- {対話型|たいわがた}⟦インターフェース→インターフェース：08793_intaafeesu⟧ (interactive interface)
- {対話型|たいわがた}⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧ (interactive exhibit)
- {対話型|たいわがた}⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧ (interactive program)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インタラクティブ — interactive (loanword; used especially in tech and media contexts)
- {双方向|そうほうこう} — bidirectional, two-way (emphasizes the two-way nature of communication)
- ⟦{参加型|さんかがた}→参加型：24317_sankagata⟧ — participatory (emphasizes audience involvement rather than dialogue)
